June 24, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Private Wealth Partners Llc increased its stake in Raytheon Co (RTN) by 357.3% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Wealth Partners Llc bought 7,682 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.91% with the market. The institutional investor held 9,832 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.12 million, up from 2,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Private Wealth Partners Llc who had been investing in Raytheon Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $55.55B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.68% or $1.32 during the last trading session, reaching $193.38. About 3.64 million shares traded or 85.47% up from the average. Raytheon Company (NYSE:RTN) has risen 29.53% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.96% the S&P500.
